description_en: Adds an audit transformation object to the list
description_zh: 添加审计转换对象到名单
name: AddAuditConversionSource

parameters.help_en: The AgentSpace to which the transformation object is added. The service verifies access permissions and region matching based on the user identity and region passed by the gateway
parameters.help_zh: 要添加转换对象的 AgentSpace。服务结合网关传入的用户身份和地域校验访问权限及地域匹配关系
parameters.name: agent_space

parameters.help_en: gateway indicates the gateway instance transform list, and trace indicates the service transform list. Only the list of the selected type is modified
parameters.help_zh: gateway 表示网关实例转换名单，trace 表示服务转换名单。只修改选定类型的名单
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the transformation object. If the type is gateway, this parameter specifies the gateway instance ID. If the type is trace, this parameter specifies the service name. The value is encoded as a single URL path segment. After decoding, leading and trailing whitespace is removed, and intermediate spaces are retained. The normalized value cannot be empty, can be up to 256 UTF-8 bytes in length, and is case-sensitive. For example, cluster A must be encoded as cluster%20A, and %20cluster%20A%20 is normalized to cluster A. A plus sign (+) in the path represents a literal plus sign and cannot be used as a space. If the value contains only whitespace or exceeds the byte limit, a 400 InvalidParameter.Config error is returned. The byte limit and normalization are verified by the backend
parameters.help_zh: gateway 时为网关实例 ID，trace 时为服务名。按单个 URL 路径段编码，解码后去除首尾空白，保留中间空格；规范化后不能为空，最长 256 个 UTF-8 字节，区分大小写。cluster A 应编码为 cluster%20A；%20cluster%20A%20 规范化为 cluster A；路径中的 + 表示加号，不能代替空格。仅空白或超过字节限制时返回 400 InvalidParameter.Config。字节限制和规范化由后端校验
parameters.name: instance_id
